nodes.title: Elevon hinge moment per servo (two panels)
nodes.equation: H = Ch_max (delta/25) q c^2 (b_in + b_out), q = rho V^2 / 2

nodes.title: Servo-to-elevon four-bar: throw, ratio, torque factor
nodes.equation: |P(theta) - Q(delta)| = L0; k(theta) = d delta / d theta; worst servo torque / H25 = max over travel of (delta/25) k

nodes.title: Servo torque required at the output vs rating
nodes.equation: T = SF x H x torque_factor (four-bar, worst point); kgf cm = N m / g x 100

nodes.title: Pushrod force, buckling and horn bond area
nodes.equation: F = H / (r_h sin phi) worst; Pcr = pi^2 E I / L^2; A_min = F sf ff pf / (kd sigma_XPS)

nodes.title: Clearances through the full mechanical travel
nodes.equation: min over delta in [-stop, stop] of the gaps: bridge rod to fin notch sides, bottom and the fixed-core skin; horn arm to the core lower skin; pushrod to the lower skin; clevis to the boss; horn plate to the clevis slot bottom

nodes.title: Surface free play, worst-case sum
nodes.equation: slop = backlash x k_neutral + (play_arm + play_horn) / r_h (rad -> deg)

nodes.title: Inter-panel rod lag, panel twist and elevon effectiveness loss
nodes.equation: rod: fixed-guided beam, d = F L^3 / (12 E I), F = H_out / r_b, lag = d / r_b; panel: uniform torque m from the drive point, tube over the first a L (GJ_h), skin + foam beyond (GJ_l): tip = m L^2 [(a - a^2/2)/GJ_h + (1-a)^2/(2 GJ_l)], mean = m L^2 [(a^2/2 - a^3/6 + (a - a^2/2)(1-a))/GJ_h + (1-a)^3/(3 GJ_l)] (a = 1: tip m L^2/2GJ, mean 2/3 tip); GJ = G_tube J_tube + 4 A^2 G_skin t / s (closed tape box) + G_xps c_e t^3 / 12; loss = mean lag / 25 deg

nodes.title: Bridge-rod choice: outboard effectiveness loss and mass per rod
nodes.equation: lag_alt = lag x (E d^4) / (E_alt d_alt^4) (same fixed-guided beam); loss_alt = loss + (lag_alt - lag) / 25 deg; m = pi d^2 / 4 x L_cut x rho

nodes.title: Servo frame bonded area and the area its load needs
nodes.equation: A = rim (Lx Ly - (Lx - 2r)(Ly - 2r)) + inboard wall Lx Hz + 2 end walls Ly Hz; Lx = ear span + 2 w, Ly = H + boss + t_arm + c + w (1.5 mm arm gap left out: conservative), Hz = W + c + w; F = T_stall / r_arm + T_stall / Lx; A_min = F sf ff pf / (kd sigma_XPS) (C6 method)
